content.text:
Here are good places to get **free 3D game assets**:

- **Kenney** — great for free, consistent low-poly game assets; many are CC0/public-domain style. ([findfree.org](https://findfree.org/resource/kenney?utm_source=openai))  
- **Poly Haven** — free 3D models, HDRIs, and PBR textures, commonly CC0. Best for realistic environments/materials. ([dev.polyhaven.com](https://dev.polyhaven.com/?utm_source=openai))  
- **OpenGameArt** — free/open game assets including 3D models, textures, music, and SFX; licenses vary, so check each asset. ([findfree.org](https://findfree.org/resource/opengameart?utm_source=openai))  
- **itch.io free 3D assets** — lots of indie asset packs for Unity, Godot, Unreal, Blender, etc.; license varies by creator. ([assethoard.com](https://assethoard.com/blog/where-to-find-free-game-assets-2026?utm_source=openai))  
- **Unity Asset Store — Free section** — good if you use Unity; includes 3D models, environments, tools, VFX, and templates. ([freegameassets.com](https://www.freegameassets.com/category/3d-models?utm_source=openai))  
- **Fab / Unreal Marketplace free assets** — useful for Unreal Engine projects; watch for assets that are Unreal-only. ([freegameassets.com](https://www.freegameassets.com/category/3d-models?utm_source=openai))  
- **Poly Pizza** — simple free low-poly models, useful for prototypes and stylized games. ([findfree.org](https://findfree.org/resource/opengameart?utm_source=openai))  
- **FreeGameAssets.com** — aggregator for free 3D models and game asset packs from places like Kenney, Unity Asset Store, Poly Haven, and others. ([freegameassets.com](https://www.freegameassets.com/?utm_source=openai))  

**Tip:** Always check the license before using assets in a commercial game. The easiest licenses are usually **CC0** or **public domain**, because they generally allow commercial use without attribution.
